code_summary: One independently trained HistoryModel per category, with separate input/output item embeddings, two learned recency-aware attention pools, last-item and mean-history features, an MLP residual encoder, normalized dot-product scores, and jointly trained item biases. Training uses sampled listwise cross-entropy with 64 negatives, prefix/positive masking, AdamW, and validation-based selection of one checkpoint per category. The predictor writer loads the matching architecture and exactly one selected checkpoint for each routed dataset; no ensemble is implemented.
